description: P0 first actionable independently verified Control AI source tasks; not the full V3-V6 acceptance backlog

tasks.goal: Improve model-native decoding and measured reasoning without forced suppression while preserving JNI cancellations, signed weights and existing WSS jobs.
Make the local PC model provider robust to structured source-edit responses, missing inference servers and checkpoint resumption without cloud dependencies.
Implement genuinely independent holdout measurement and contamination-safe evidence handling with no invented evaluation scores.
Harden reviewed licensed dataset preparation and genuine adapter-training validation without training on holdout cases or silently downloading weights.
Improve deterministic dependency selection, persistence and crash reconciliation while preserving existing overnight supervisor and human override.
Verify signed WSS tool allowlists and receipt postconditions, keeping specialist engines delegated rather than duplicating their work.
